methodologyNotes: Pricing fetched directly from each vendor's official pricing page using WebFetch. Where the official page returned no prices (JS-only render, configurator-gated, or quote-only), reputable third-party comparison sources (GetApp, SoftwareAdvice) were used and noted in provenance. accessedAt set to 2026-06-14 per dataset convention. monthlyUsd for annual-only plans is the annualized monthly rate; month-to-month rates noted where available.
